quote: In metrics selection, we follow the original papers' settings. Specifically, for CrossCodeEval, we measure performance with code match and identifier match metrics, assessing accuracy with exact match (EM), edit similarity (ES), and F1 scores. SWE-bench utilizes % Resolved (Pass@1) to gauge the effectiveness of model-generated patches based on provided unit tests. EvoCodeBench employs Pass@k, where k represents the number of generated programs, for functional correctness and Recall@k to assess the recall of reference dependencies in generated programs.
